## Welcome {.white-text background-color="#003366"}

Καλώς ήρθατε στο διήμερο σεμινάριο για **Spatial Data & Biodiversity in R**

::: fragment
*Department of Biology · University of Patras · 2026*
:::

## Why R for Spatial Ecology?

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **Reproducible** scripted workflows
-   Mature spatial stack (`sf`, `terra`, `stars`)
-   Direct access to **GBIF**, climate, elevation APIs
-   Powerful biodiversity packages (`vegan`, `iNEXT`, `betapart`)
-   Integrated reporting via **Quarto**
:::

:::: {.column width="50%"}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rgbif)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
```
:::


::: callout-tip
One language, end-to-end pipeline.
:::
::::
::::::

## Seminar Overview

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Day 1 — Spatial Data

-   GIS fundamentals & CRS
-   Open biodiversity data sources
-   Programmatic retrieval with `rgbif`
-   Cleaning with `CoordinateCleaner`
-   Hands-on lab session
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Day 2 — Biodiversity Patterns

-   α, β, γ diversity (`vegan`, `betapart`)
-   Rarefaction & Hill numbers (`iNEXT`)
-   Species Distribution Modeling (`predicts`, `biomod2`)
-   Biogeographical regionalization
-   Mediterranean case study
:::
:::::

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this seminar, you will be able to:

1.  **Retrieve** occurrence and environmental data programmatically in R
2.  **Process** spatial datasets reproducibly with `sf` and `terra`
3.  **Quantify** biodiversity using appropriate metrics
4.  **Model** species distributions across environmental gradients
5.  **Interpret** biogeographical patterns ecologically

::: callout-tip
All code, datasets, and slides are versioned on GitHub.
:::

## Setup & Prerequisites


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# 1. Clone the repository
# git clone https://github.com/yourusername/seminar-patras

# 2. Open the project in RStudio

# 3. Run the setup script
source("setup.R")

# 4. Render the slides
quarto::quarto_render("day1-spatial-data.qmd")
```
:::


::: callout-note
## Software requirements

R ≥ 4.3 · RStudio · Quarto ≥ 1.4 · Git · \~2 GB free disk space for spatial layers
:::

## Agenda — Day 1 {background-color="#F8F9FA"}

| Time        | Module                            | Format         |
|-------------|-----------------------------------|----------------|
| 09:00–10:30 | Spatial data fundamentals         | Lecture        |
| 11:00–12:30 | CRS, projections & `sf`/`terra`   | Lecture + Demo |
| 13:30–15:00 | GBIF data retrieval with `rgbif`  | Hands-on       |
| 15:30–17:00 | Cleaning with `CoordinateCleaner` | Hands-on       |

## Agenda — Day 2 {background-color="#F8F9FA"}

| Time        | Module                          | Format         |
|-------------|---------------------------------|----------------|
| 09:00–10:30 | Biodiversity metrics in `vegan` | Lecture        |
| 11:00–12:30 | SDM with `predicts` & `biomod2` | Lecture + Demo |
| 13:30–15:00 | β-diversity & biogeography      | Hands-on       |
| 15:30–17:00 | Mediterranean case study        | Workshop       |

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
